name: Alex
label: Long-term Premium user, happy overall
who: I have been a Spotify Premium subscriber for many years and use it on all my devices, sometimes through a family or student plan. I listen daily and value playlists I can share with friends, Spotify Connect and the overall experience.
value_for_money: They say Premium is worth it. One calls it a really good deal for music and podcasts with no ads, and another says it gives more value than other subscriptions. Others point out that Tidal offers better audio at a similar price and that a student bundle lowered the cost for them.
loyalty: Shared playlists, Spotify Connect and downloads keep them on Spotify, and several tried Apple Music before returning or staying for the social features. Switching would mean rebuilding playlists, and quality or UI declines are the concerns they raise.
pain_points: Premium seen as overpriced for light use
reasons_to_stay: They value Premium's ad-free listening, downloads, casting and collaborative playlists with friends, and say those features are worth paying for. Several tried Apple Music or Tidal and kept Spotify for its social features and ease of use.
tone: Upbeat and conversational, supporting Spotify with personal anecdotes and reasons, sometimes with humor.
